disclaimer: Savings Lab v2 is a local-first calculator that runs entirely in the browser.
No user data is collected, stored, transmitted, or tracked.
No cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB are used.
No analytics, telemetry, or third-party scripts are loaded.
All calculations are performed client-side using JavaScript arithmetic.
The calculator does not represent any specific product, merchant, or offer.
Results are hypothetical estimates for educational budgeting purposes only.
